response.justification: Bogdan is a talented full-stack engineer with strong software craftsmanship fundamentals, but represents a significant mismatch for this Technical Lead role. Most critically, he has only ~1 year of C++ experience against the required 8 years—a fundamental technical gap for a position centered on cloud compute platform strategy. Additionally, he lacks the 2-3 years of formal technical leadership and cloud/DevOps team mentoring needed for mid-senior level. His career trajectory has been generalist full-stack development (web, mobile, embedded) rather than specialized cloud infrastructure engineering. While his recent Staff role shows leadership progression, it is only 4 months old and focused on full-stack work rather than platform leadership.
strengths: Demonstrated experience building distributed systems handling millions of requests/second and working with microservices infrastructure at Dunnhumby
Strong foundation in software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, code quality standards, and mentoring through workshops and open-source projects
Proven ability to architect and own complex technical projects (GISCollective platform, multiple deployments across Kubernetes and AWS CDK)
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise: only ~6 months professional C++ experience (National Instruments 2014-2015) versus required 8 years; current tech stack is TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No demonstrated formal technical leadership experience; Staff role began only 4 months ago and remains primarily full-stack engineer responsibilities, not team mentoring or platform strategy

Career is generalist full-stack development rather than specialized cloud infrastructure and compute platform architecture; cloud exposure is limited to AWS CDK and Kubernetes deployments, not deep platform expertise
